To change the loss assumptions of a finished EPR result without AEDT or
Palace, `reanalyze_epr` works offline; see
[Change loss assumptions without solving](../guides/offline-loss.qmd).
How SCGSim is built inside is under [Contribute](../contribute/index.qmd).

[]{#junction-capacitance-reference}A junction's capacitive participation and
its effective modal capacitance are defined with the other EPR formulas in
[How EPR is normalized](specs/aedt-runtime.qmd#surface-estimates-and-junction-normalization).
